mintAuthority.summary: M's immutable Ethereum MinterGateway currently uses approved minters, validator attestations and collateral/debt accounting. TTG can appoint minters/validators and set the attestation threshold to zero, permitting arbitrary reported off-chain collateral and durable issuance to a chosen destination without posted deposits. D14 is unbounded with periodic attestation reconciliation. Emergency governance has no unavoidable 48-hour execution delay; the mutable 300-second mint delay is not that delay. Bridge representations remain assessed separately.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway
controls.capDescription: MToken.mint is callable only by the MinterGateway; MinterGateway issuance depends on TTG-approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and collateral/debt checks.
controls.evidence: Re-verified at Ethereum block 25712124: MToken.minterGateway() returned this immutable MinterGateway and ttgRegistrar() returned 0x119fbeedd4f4f4298fb59b720d5654442b81ae2c. The gateway enforces approved-minter, validator-attestation, delay, and collateral-ratio constraints but does not itself govern their values, so canRaiseCap is false for this contract. TTG governance is modeled separately as the cap raiser.

controls.label: M0 TTG Registrar governance
controls.capDescription: M0 Two Token Governance controls Registrar configuration used by MinterGateway, including approved minter/validator parameters, collateral update intervals, mint delay, and mint ratio.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712124, MinterGateway.ttgRegistrar() returned this Registrar. M0's primary governance and role specifications assign approved-minter, validator, and issuance-parameter changes to Two Token Governance. This control can authorize new issuance participants and raise replaceable mint constraints but cannot bypass MinterGateway's transaction checks directly.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25773291, MToken.minterGateway() still resolved to the immutable MinterGateway and ttgRegistrar() returned 0x119fbeedd4f4f4298fb59b720d5654442b81ae2c. Existing pinned reads establish mint ratio 9950, mint delay 300 seconds, validator threshold 1, and a 108000-second collateral update interval; expired collateral counts as zero. M0's primary specifications assign replaceable issuance parameters and approved minter/validator sets to TTG governance, so native M issuance remains collateral/debt and Validator constrained while aggregate cap semantics are raiseable. Validator attestations support periodic reconciliation; no unified prudential supervisor or public native mint-authority incident was identified in the reviewed primary sources. Solana and the other authored deployments are bridge representations and their route controls are assessed separately under Bridge Risk. D14/D29 sweep 2026-10-03 supersedes the historical raiseable classification: at Ethereum block 26113566 (hash 0x8ee5bf8702023bb24470045b03b62f22fe10f1c46654ea9e79377e5dac7193b9), mintDelay()=300, mintRatio()=9950 and updateCollateralValidatorThreshold()=1. Verified Registrar.setKey/addToList admit Standard Governor 0xb024ac5a7c6bc92fbacc8c3387e628a07e1da016 and Emergency Governor 0x886d405949f709bc3f4451491bdd07ff51cdf90a. The signature threshold has no positive lower bound; setting it to zero permits an approved minter to report arbitrary collateral with empty signature arrays, then proposeMint(amount,destination) and mintM after the configured delay. These balances are off-chain attestations, not posted deposits; governance can also appoint its own minter and validator. D14 is unbounded notwithstanding current checks. D29 fails the minimum-delay gate: Emergency ThresholdGovernor has zero voting delay and a supermajority proposal can execute while the current voting epoch is open, without an enforced 48-hour timelock. The mutable 300-second mint delay is not a governance delay. Registrar is not itself the sole token-vote governor; complete recursive TTG/minter/validator executionScope closure is not certified. Periodic validator reconciliation and attestation-only supervision yield unbounded-reconciled.
